allocation_and_clock_evidence.plan_approval_date_status: Conflicting source statements; original HUD plan-approval letter not located. This is a different event from the grant agreement effective date.
allocation_and_clock_evidence.amendment_3_status: May 2017 document describes allocating remaining funds. Page 4 says the final version was published following May 8–14 public comment; HUD approval/effective date is not established from reviewed source.
allocation_and_clock_evidence.amendment_2_retroactive_approval_note: The May 2017 amendment says the city requested and received approval for amendment #2 in September 2015; no exact HUD approval date is stated here.
allocation_and_clock_evidence.qpr_2017q3_approval_note: The QPR says HUD approved amendments moving funds from two activities, but the reviewed passage does not identify amendment #3 or give an approval date.
allocation_and_clock_evidence.limitations: Whole-grant federal allocation differs from partial action-plan amounts, QPR programmed budget, and beneficiary allocations. Full historical amendment and program-income chronology not yet verified.

notes: A 2013-12-13 initial agreement effective date is reported by two HUD financial summaries; Q1 is the calendar quarter containing that date and can be partial.
2013Q4 and 2019Q4–2024Q4 reports were not found in the checked HUD metadata and city report index; this does not establish nonexistence or zero activity.
A source-version implied opening is to-date minus this-period; it is not certified as the grant-start opening. Adjacent matching values do not prove complete history.
Individual QPR listed activities may be incomplete; QPR-only IDs are included without an inferred F31 crosswalk. Extension IDs may be related to other activities and must not automatically be added.
Projects, activities and award totals are nested scopes; do not add them together, add cumulative values across quarters, or combine QPR snapshots with F31 transactions.
Administering-city identity does not establish beneficiary location. Activity titles and source narratives are not exported.
Project funds budgeted and grant Total Budget are different reported scopes and can disagree; listed-activity totals are diagnostics, not proof of complete activity history.

2017Q3 total budget rose $8,032,332.09 versus the prior source while the report lists $0 budget for the period; listed activity budget is $7,990,000 below the grant total. The source does not establish why; original figures and versions remain unchanged.

The stricter whole-grant Q12/Q20 allocation fields remain blank pending historical amendment and program-income reconciliation; separately labelled descriptive QPR reported-award ratios are available in v49 evidence.
